scope: Star Trek Academy domain contracts/reference simulation

runtime_ownership.star_trek_repo: domain contracts, content, fixtures, deterministic reference resolvers
runtime_ownership.core_rpg: generic live state, persistence, scheduler, action/event execution, LOD runtime

hard_invariants: Persistent identity survives materialization and LOD.
Player discretionary choices are never auto-selected.
Adult heterosexual romance canon remains locked.
Consent remains contextual and cannot be inferred.
Good wellbeing preserves normal capacity rather than creating superhuman buffs.
Consequences require obligation/evidence/context; discipline requires due process.
Campus events do not spawn for pacing.
Off-screen time does not create progression or relationships by itself.
Graduation completion may unlock future skip-Academy play but does not fabricate assignment.
Final closure status is derived from repository introspection, not trusted self-asserted fixture booleans.
